errors.wrong: The original names a parody figure, "Tony Bobbins" (Тоні Боббінс). The translation swaps in the real coach Tony Robbins, so the reader takes the 390,000 claim as being about a real person.

The original says the assistants set up the payment form within twenty minutes, during the stream. The translation reads as twenty minutes after the stream began, which contradicts the two hours that had already passed.
